label: topology-uniform
tail:
A1/A2 are complete; A4 was correctly left untouched pending A3 approval.

- Audited 61 items, including 45 proofs, 180 numbered steps, and 188 dependency citations, with no coverage exceptions.
- Provenance: 19 exact-source, 21 semantic-source, and 21 established-knowledge determinations awaiting Alpha concurrence. No Statement was labeled AI-generated.
- Found 11 coupled empty-carrier failures caused by the proper-filter convention, plus citation defects in symmetric roots, completion, compactness, uniformization, and examples.
- Strict proof-contract gate: 45/45, zero errors or warnings.
- Finite-smoke gate: zero errors.

The principal literature checks used [Wodzicki’s uniform-structure notes](https://math.berkeley.edu/~wodzicki/H104.F13/UniformStructure-alt.pdf), the [Encyclopedia of Mathematics](https://encyclopediaofmath.org/wiki/Uniform_space), [Vienna’s general-topology notes](https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~mike/teaching/ss16/general_topology.pdf), and [BIU’s topological-group notes](https://u.math.biu.ac.il/~megereli/TGrNotes070217.pdf).
